protocol.order: block, then 512/768/1024; adjacent variant pairs; EXP-003 first in odd blocks

interpretation.decision: I accept the recorded run and retain EXP-005 as the next research reference for its observed keygen benefit, with the small-effect uncertainty and Kyber1024 decap regression retained. Final selection remains subject to repeat-session evaluation and the planned security assessment.
interpretation.keygen: All fifteen pairs favour EXP-005. Median reductions are 5.1832%, 0.4761% and 1.3643%. Both order-group medians are positive. The small Kyber768 effect is comparable to movements in unchanged operations and needs confirmation.
interpretation.other_operations: Kyber512 and Kyber768 encap/decap show small positive movements without saved error-vector reductions. Kyber1024 encap is mixed (-0.1150% median, 2/5 positive) and decap regresses (-0.5000%, 4/5 negative); neither is removed from analysis.
interpretation.followup: The enc_derand, dec, indcpa_enc and indcpa_dec normalized bodies match between variants. KEM entry locations match, but IND-CPA encryption/decryption entries move by 16 bytes for Kyber512 and 32 for Kyber768/1024. This demonstrates layout changes, not their causal contribution to timing.
interpretation.scope: Five pairs in one session, identical repeated fixtures and three/two order groups. No formal significance, causal separation of reduction-call cost, cross-machine guarantee or cumulative original-baseline speed claim is established.
interpretation.raw_extremes: All observations are retained, including the largest duration of 1190035 ns. Timer resolution is 1 ns; empty probes are 11-12 ns and were not subtracted.

security_findings.accepted_validation: Actual timing source identities and all 24 reviewed function bodies match accepted EXP-005 validation. Bounds 23299/26627 for Kyber512 and 23298/26626 for the others remain conditional on the exact call path; tested KEM bytes and exercised UBSan evidence are inherited, not rerun.
security_findings.hardening: Keygen canaries, endbr64 and page probes remain. Keygen code grows 17/33/40 bytes and local stack changes +16/+16/0 bytes relative to EXP-003. The EXP-002 dot-product canary tradeoff persists.
security_findings.not_measured: This performance run does not compare secret-input classes and is not a leakage assessment. Whole-program constant-time behavior, statistical leakage resistance, power/EM and fault behavior remain unestablished or unassessed.
security_findings.supervisor_requirement: The user clarified that evaluating how optimisations affect implementation security is required practical work; VTune was suggested optionally. I schedule complementary secret-flow and statistical timing checks before declaring the practical component complete.
